Usage: bukio [options] [command]

Agent-first bookkeeping for SMEs across thirty-one jurisdictions — SQLite,
VAT-optional

Options:
  -V, --version         output the version number
  --json                machine-readable JSON output
  --db <path>           database file (default: "/root/.bukio/bukio.db")
  --actor <who>         acting entity '<role>:<name>' — e.g. agent:bartholomeus,
                        human:erik (or BUKIO_ACTOR env; required)
  --sign-key <path>     explicit private-key file to sign with (default: the
                        actor's key in <config>/keys)
  --server <url>        remote bukio server — POST a signed command envelope
                        instead of running locally (or BUKIO_SERVER env)
  --locale <code>       output language for human-facing text (or BUKIO_LOCALE
                        env; default: English — explicit opt-in; tables: en, nl,
                        nl-be, de, fr, fr-lu, da, fi, nb, sv)
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]        initialise a company database (file, company row,
                        default chart)
  entry                 journal entries
  account               chart of accounts
  report                reports
  audit [options]       read the append-only audit log
  backup [options]      create a consistent SQLite backup of the database
                        (optionally encrypted)
  restore [options]     restore a database from a backup file (encrypted backups
                        auto-detected)
  bank                  bank accounts, import and matching

  recurring             recurring entries: templates, schedule, generation
  depreciation          depreciation schedules (linear, remainder-adjusted final

                        BUKIO_MCP_READONLY=1 -> plan-only mutations
  compliance            filing deadlines (OB/ICP/jaarrekening) — never
                        auto-files
  import                import data: opening balances, journal CSV, XAF 4.0

  export                export data for external advisors: XAF 4.0 audit file

                           roles, or --for <who> to see another's (owner only
